userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: A command transitioned lifecycle state (data: Command).
A device changed state (data: DeviceStatus).
An alert was raised (data: Alert).
An alert changed lifecycle state (data: Alert).
A reservation reached its no-show condition (data: ReservationSummary; subject: the AssignedRight).
A toll transaction was created (data: TollTransaction).
A toll transaction changed status, including disputes (data: TollTransaction).
A subscription exhausted its retry schedule and was marked failed (data: SubscriptionFailure; subject: the subscription, className ApxEventSubscription).
Occupancy changed materially for a place element — threshold crossing or publisher-defined delta (data: OccupancySnapshot).
A payment was recorded — taken via /v1/payments or ingested from a lane device (data: PaymentRecord). Fills the financial-analytics gap: APDS EventTypeEnum has no payment events.

A new Observation was ingested — LPR read, RFID hit, sensor event (data: the APDS ObservationElement, one event per element; subject references it; elementIds carries the lane or place). Fills the sensor-analytics gap: APDS EventTypeEnum has no Observation events.
A resolution context was created or materially recomputed (data: ResolutionContext) — enables event-driven preloading so agent consoles pop before the call is answered.
A support interaction was recorded or updated (data: SupportInteraction).
A violation candidate was recorded from automated, guided, or manual detection (data: Violation) — drives guided-enforcement handheld queues.
A notice, warning, or citation was issued on a violation (data: Violation).
A violation changed lifecycle state — review, payment, appeal open/resolve, void (data: Violation).
A validation was applied to a ticket/session from any channel, or reversed (data: ValidationRedemption).
A validation program was enrolled, suspended, resumed, or ended (data: ValidationProgram).
A merchant billing period was closed into an immutable statement (data: ValidationStatement).
A credential was issued, activated, suspended, resumed, reported lost, revoked, expired, or replaced (data: CredentialRecord).

A credential was presented at a lane and access was granted or denied (data: AccessEvent; a CredentialAccessEvent whenever a record matched, Part 21 §21.4). Fills the gap: APDS EventTypeEnum has no access events.
A valet ticket changed lifecycle state — dropped, parked, retrieving, staged, handed back, closed, cancelled (data: ValetTicket).
A customer or attendant requested a valeted vehicle; carries channel, ETA, and promised time (data: ValetTicket) — drives runner boards and customer notifications.
A permit pool's issued count or capacity changed (data: PoolAvailability; subject: the RightSpecification). Optional for apx-permits (Part 14 §14.2c).

An ingested Observation was replaced through native PUT /observations/{id} — e.g. the LPR system revised accessEvent (data: the APDS ObservationElement as it now stands; subject and elementIds place binding as for apx.data.observation.created.v1; consumers keep the highest version). Required for apx-lpr (Part 13 §13.4).

A ChargingSession transitioned lifecycle state — authorized, pluggedIn, charging, suspended, complete, idle, unplugged, closed, cancelled, faulted (data: ChargingSession; place-bound on ChargingSession.place). Required for apx-charging (Part 23 §23.12).

A ChargingSession entered idle after its idlePolicy grace elapsed with the cable still connected; carries the idle policy and the minimized vehicle summary (data: ChargingSession) — drives the customer's move-your-car notification and the Part 19 enforcement hook. Required for apx-charging (Part 23 §23.2, §23.10).
A charging point's availability or bay presence changed (data: ChargingPointStatus; place-bound on ChargingPointStatus.place). Required for apx-charging (Part 23 §23.1, §23.3).

A plate list or one of its entries was created, changed, or removed (data: PlateList with entryCount; subject: the list). Consumers resync entries through the Part 5 feed on /v1/plate-lists/{id}/entries. Required for apx-plate-lists (Part 24 §24.3).
A UI launch was issued, opened, closed, or expired (data: UiLaunch without url; subject: the launch; place-bound on UiLaunch.place). Required for apx-ui-launch (Part 25 §25.3).

An action done in a launched vendor screen was recorded as a UiActionRecord because no native resource could express it (data: UiActionRecord; subject: the launch; carries the launch's correlationId). Required for apx-ui-launch (Part 25 §25.4).

A piece of equipment or its APX decorations (equipment-detail, camera, external-ids) was added, changed, or removed (data: EquipmentRecord; subject: the SupplementalEquipment; place-bound). Lets other systems stay in sync without re-reading the place. Required for apx-site-config (Part 26 §26.8).
A comms point was added, changed, or removed (data: CommsPoint; subject: the comms point; place-bound). Required for apx-site-config (Part 26 §26.8).

An approval request was created, decided, or expired (data: ApprovalRequest; subject: the request; place-bound). An approver's system subscribes to it for its queue. Required for apx-resolution when approvals are offered (Part 17 §17.8).
